scope: Second-pass search for any independent GLM Coding Plan absolute-token evidence after glm-community-round1-2026-09-07.json. All sources allowed: official docs, quota API captures, V2EX, linux.do, HN, Reddit, GitHub monitors, jia.je, ACP, blogs. Do not change adopted.csv from this file.
method: Coordinator web search + primary-page fetch + GitHub code/issue lookup + browser attempt on Reddit. Reddit still blocked (403 / network policy). linux.do full threads often JS-walled. No invented numbers; contradictions kept side-by-side. V1/V2 retained and tagged; must not be mixed into V3 5.3 adoption.
